_about.how: Copy this folder, give it your brand's short name, and fill each slot. Leave a slot empty when you have nothing for it. Delete this _about block when you are done.
_about.brand: Your brand's name, as you write it.
_about.owner: The company that owns the brand.
_about.rules_version: A date and a number, such as 2026-11-21.1. Change it at every edit; the server writes it beside every answer and every log line.
_about.read_on: The day you read the sources below.
_about.roots: Folders outside this one that a checker or an asset lives in, by name, each relative to this folder. Example: {"tools": "../../our-brand-tools"}. Write {tools} in a checker command or an asset path to use one.
_about.rules: One object per rule: id, area (positioning, voice, logo, color, type, layout, naming or legal), rule (one sentence to follow), source (the file or address it comes from), audiences (["all"], or staff, partner, agency), status (current or old).
_about.colors: One object per approved color: hex (#RRGGBB), name, and where it may be used. check_draft fails any other hex in a text.
_about.typefaces: One object per typeface: name, use, and where the file is.
_about.assets: One object per approved file: id, kind (logo, wordmark, icon or template), name, and file or url.
_about.claims: One object per approved claim: id, claim (the exact sentence), proof_url (the public page that states it), read_on, expires (a date, or null). A sentence in a draft matches a claim when it uses 60% of the claim's words and adds no number.
_about.claim_words: A regular expression for the words that make a sentence a claim in your market, such as \b(fastest|safest|only|\d+ ?%)\b. A sentence with one of them must match an approved claim, or a person looks at it.
_about.word_limit: Optional. A word you allow only a few times per piece, such as puns on your mascot: {"name", "max", "pattern" (a regular expression), "why"}. More than max sends the draft to a person.
_about.names: correct: the ways to write the brand. wrong: the ways never to write it; check_draft fails each one. partner_patterns: optional, a list of {pattern, rule, fix} tested only on partner and agency drafts.
_about.banned_phrases: One object per phrase: phrase, why, and skip_kind "internal" when the phrase is fine inside the company.
_about.legal_lines: One object per legal line: line, when it is needed, source_url.
_about.owners: Who answers a request_exception, per rule area, with a default.
_about.checkers: Your own checkers, per kind of draft: text, page or narration. Each is a command as a list of words. {file} is the draft, {brand} is this folder, and any root name is that root. Each command prints one JSON object: {"verdict": "pass" | "fail" | "person_must_look", "failures": [{"rule", "found", "fix"}], "person_must_look": [{"sentence", "why"}]}.
